calendarNotes: Parkway's 2027–28 academic calendar distinguishes no-school days from districtwide half days and high-school-only finals. Half-day dismissal depends on the student's school tier: Tier 1 dismisses at 11:35 a.m., Tier 2 at 12:30 p.m., and Tier 3 at 1:05 p.m. The Tier 2 time is ten minutes later than the published 2026–27 time. The PDF labels April 24 only as No School and gives no reason, so this page preserves the generic label. Summer-school dates remain visible after the regular last day but are excluded from the downloadable ICS calendar.

customSections.label: Key Changes from 2026–27
customSections.content: The first day moves from August 25 to August 24, while the last regular school day moves from May 28 to May 26. Spring Break shifts to March 20–24, and Parkway's published Tier 2 half-day dismissal changes from 12:20 to 12:30 p.m.

customSections.label: How Parkway Half Days Work
customSections.content: Parkway publishes three dismissal tiers rather than one districtwide half-day time. The district calendar lists all three dismissal times but does not identify which schools use each tier, so families should confirm their school's tier before arranging pickup. High school finals are half days for grades 9–12. Teacher Records Days and the last day of school use the PK–12 half-day schedule.

customSections.label: Dates That Need Extra Attention
customSections.content: Three details in Parkway's 2027–28 calendar need extra context: April 24 has no stated reason, high school finals apply only to grades 9–12, and the published calendar continues into summer-school dates after the regular student year.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 17, 2026, against Parkway's District Calendar page, the published 2027–28 academic PDF, and the 2026–27 academic PDF used for year-over-year comparisons.
sourceReviewDetails: We verified every published academic-calendar entry against the PDF currently linked by Parkway, including overlapping December and May finals and PK–12 half days.
We record multi-day finals, Thanksgiving, Winter Break, Spring Break, and summer-school ranges exactly as Parkway publishes them rather than inferring dates from adjacent entries.
Half-day dismissal times were checked visually; the 2027–28 Tier 2 time is 12:30 p.m., compared with 12:20 p.m. on the 2026–27 calendar.
The PDF labels April 24 only as No School. We do not infer a reason that Parkway did not provide.

calendarFaqs.q: When do Parkway students return after winter break?
calendarFaqs.a: January 3 is a Teacher Records Day, so there is no school. Students return Tuesday, January 4, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When is spring break for Parkway Schools in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Parkway Spring Break runs Monday, March 20, through Friday, March 24, 2028. Students return Monday, March 27.

calendarFaqs.q: What time does Parkway dismiss on half days in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: The calendar lists 11:35 a.m. for Tier 1, 12:30 p.m. for Tier 2, and 1:05 p.m. for Tier 3. Confirm which tier your school uses.

calendarFaqs.q: Why is April 24, 2028, a no-school day?
calendarFaqs.a: Parkway's academic PDF labels April 24 only as No School and does not give a reason. This page preserves the district's generic label rather than guessing.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Parkway in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The last regular school day is Friday, May 26, 2028. It is a half day for grades PK–12.
